title: Asymptotic equivalence and exact values for second-order Zarankiewicz numbers
summary: The recursive-line and signed Zarankiewicz numbers maximize the number of squares in augmentations of a maximum $C_4$-free base, subject to two sufficient irreducibility criteria. The count includes one square per base cell and one per selected pair of unused cells. We compare these parameters with the second-order number, which uses irreducibility itself. Every maximum $m\times n$ base admits a recursive-line augmentation with at least $mn/2-C\max(m,n)$ squares, for an absolute constant $C$.
